issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אֵלָיו פִּי קָרָאתִי' means 'I called to Him with my mouth' (or 'my mouth I called to Him'), but the Chinese '我向他口中呼求' renders '向他口中' ('to His mouth'), incorrectly making the object 'His mouth' instead of 'my mouth' (פִּי is 'my mouth', not 'His mouth'). This changes who is doing what to whom.
